name: Halloween Sword
note: Halloween 2026's top prize (7000 Candy; coordinator 19:2x 2026-10-28, Justin: the purple sword model, replicated exactly, as the cue body). Drawn by its own body piece (halloween_sword): a purple-black blade with a raised ridge and glowing violet flame edges, a carved jack-o'-lantern guard with bat wings, a wrapped grip, a crystal pommel. Concept: mocks/v2/C8_halloween_sword.png. Lane hw-cues-a. Core adds the Catalog and Track rows. v3 (lane cuesB, 2026-10-29) tried painted toon flames and a fire face; v4 (designer 2026-10-29 ~14:20: the older version was better, no flat 2D flame pictures): the aura is back to the soft flames of before v3.

Moving.Note: The body itself: the flame edges shimmer (a hair of hinge about the axis, 1.6 s); the carved face's light flickers (Aura Lights); the rest is the sword, still, as the art.

Aura.Note: C8's IDLE EFFECT: light purple flames licking along the blade (the shared painted fire sheet turned violet, opaque, low light emission so it never turns to mush on the bright floor), a few violet sparks drifting off the edges, a thin dark mist behind the pumpkin guard; the carved face's light flickers. No beam, no orbiter, no ribbon. v5: the flame border is VFX (two scrolling painted flame beams along the edges plus edge flame particles), the blade mesh itself is the dark core with its ridge and a thin lavender bevel.

Emitters.Name: EdgeFlamesL
Emitters.Note: the licking flames off the blade edge (an effect: free to overlap the bridge hand; off under Lower effects, the beams stay)

Emitters.Name: EdgeFlamesR
Emitters.Note: the licking flames off the blade edge (an effect: free to overlap the bridge hand; off under Lower effects, the beams stay)

Beams.Name: EdgeFlameL
Beams.Note: C8's flame border as VFX (designer 20:5x): a painted flame strip (dark violet bodies, a lavender line on the blade's edge, tongues both ways) scrolling along the edge; camera-facing so it licks outward from every view; no light emission, it reads on the bright floor only opaque and dark (lab 21:5x)

Beams.Name: EdgeFlameR
Beams.Note: C8's flame border as VFX (designer 20:5x): a painted flame strip (dark violet bodies, a lavender line on the blade's edge, tongues both ways) scrolling along the edge; camera-facing so it licks outward from every view; no light emission, it reads on the bright floor only opaque and dark (lab 21:5x)

Trail.Note: C8's SLASH EFFECT, v4 (designer 2026-10-29: keep the dark trail, no flat flames): the v3 deep-violet slash painted with the sword's own flame border (flame_strip, fading to near-black violet behind; in game stretched once along a ribbon of at most 0.45 s, Config.Effects), a thin lilac core, violet sparks and soft glowing embers drifting up off it with a faint violet glow, a little dark-violet smoke.

Emitters.Name: SlashEmbers
Emitters.Note: soft glowing embers drifting up off the slash (additive, no painted flame); in game they live half their row's life (Config.Effects.TrailEmitterLifetimeScale): 0.5-0.8 s

Emitters.Name: SlashGlow
Emitters.Note: a faint violet glow round the embers, so the slash reads as light, not a ribbon alone

Pocket.Note: About 2.1 s (C8's WIN EFFECT, v4b: designer 2026-10-29, 'purple energy burst' about half the v3 face's size, held to about 1.5 s; all glow, no drawn picture, on the hole): a violet flash; a pool of violet light, four glowing rings and light streaks racing out across the cloth from the hole; a dark violet smoke core rising up the column (not additive), so the light over it adds up to violet instead of pink or white on a bright pink or blue cloth; a violet light column about 2.6 studs tall (soft glows shot up the hole and held there by drag, so it keeps its size from a high camera, round a brighter violet heart and a squashed glow along it) with a soft aura and an orb in the pocket mouth, thin light pillars shooting up round it; three waves of soft purple fire tongues (the white energy flame, additive) licking up out of the pocket to about 2.1 s; sparks; sparkles round the column; glow motes drifting up. Every layer is born at the hole at or just over the cloth (none under it) and the flat ones lie on the cloth centred on it. The layers over the cloth are half blended (LightEmission 0.5-0.7) and the shared gust's cores stay violet (Style CoreWhiten 0.2), so it tints a bright cloth violet instead of adding up to white on it. No sound.

Layers.Name: FloorGlow
Layers.Note: a pool of violet light on the cloth round the hole (half blended: it tints a bright cloth)

Layers.Name: RingFast

Layers.Name: RingLate

Layers.Note: the violet light column: seven soft glows shot up the hole and held by drag (no Squash, so it keeps its size from a high camera), about 2.6 studs tall

Layers.Note: the brighter heart of the column, violet rather than white

Layers.Name: ColumnBeam

Layers.Name: Pillars

Layers.Name: Wisps

Layers.Name: LastWisps

Layers.Name: Motes
Layers.Note: glow motes drifting up as it ends

Budget.Note: v4 (2026-10-29): the aura is back to its rows before v3: 5.5+5.5 soft edge flames (flame_4x4), 6 sparks, 4 mist = 21/s steady, half on the back; Lower effects hides the edge flames (10/s left: sparks, mist; the two border beams stay). Plus the body (5 parts, 8,784 tris: the Meshy sword split and re-proportioned, a 512 colour atlas, a 512 emissive mask, a 256 wrap tile); textures: flame_4x4 1024, flame_strip 512x128, energy_flame 1024 and v2 streak 512 (the finisher's, both shared). Trail 32/s while the ball moves (10 sparks, 14 embers, 4 glow, 4 smoke; no flat flames). The finisher bursts 116 particles once (v3 159, v4 107), glow (LightEmission 0.5 to 1) but for a 10-puff dark violet smoke core (up to 2.9 studs); the biggest are the soft aura (4 studs, about a third of it shows), the floor glow and rings (flat on the cloth, up to 3.4 studs), the column (3-stud soft glows stacked about 2.6 studs tall) and the fire tongues (up to 2.4 studs); held to about 1.5 s and gone by about 2.15 s; no 3D piece.
